personajes.en: Tikuna woman, copper-brown skin, long black hair in low ponytail, floral printed blouse and elastic skirt, rubber sandals, red and black geometric wristband, carrying woven chakru basket filled with plantains and fish.

Mestizo man, weathered olive skin, graying hair combed back, sweat-stained light shirt unbuttoned over white undershirt, dark trousers, worn sneakers, handheld calculator and padlocked cashbox on counter beside him.
Murui man, bronze skin, straight black hair to shoulders, cut-off denim shorts, faded t-shirt, high rubber boots, machete in right hand, small sack of yuca cuttings slung across back.

Young mestizo man, brown skin, short curly black hair, striped polo shirt, knee-length shorts, flip-flops, bandana around neck, holding motorcycle helmet under one arm, phone pouch strapped across chest.
Afro-Colombian woman, deep brown skin, braided hair with small clips, simple cotton blouse in pale yellow, dark jeans, flat sandals, notebook and pen in hand, reading glasses hanging from collar.

Puinave teenager, warm brown skin, straight black hair with fringe, plain dark hoodie despite heat, athletic shorts, cheap rubber sandals, backpack over one shoulder,的手机 tucked in hand — replace with phone held loosely.

Elderly Tikuna man, sun-wrinkled amber skin, thin white hair, white guayabera-style shirt over gray trousers, rubber sandals, traditional red-black painted beads around neck, hands shaping a small balsa wood animal carving.

Cubeo woman, tawny skin, black hair braided with red cord, practical sleeveless blouse and rolled canvas trousers, rubber boots, net and woven fishing trap over shoulder, keychain of community store keys at waist.
